chunks: Ali, from his father, from Al-Naw ibn al-Hakam, from Al-Nawfaly, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said:

Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Every treacherous one will come on the Day of Judgment with an imam (leader), with a lopsided mouth, until he enters the Fire; and every breaker of the allegiance to an Imam will come as a leper (mutilated), until he enters the Fire.'

key_terms.أَجْذَمَ: Leper or one with a specific deformity (often interpreted as lacking a hand or foot, or having leprosy)
key_terms.إِمَام: Leader or guide; here referring to a leader accompanying the individual in the afterlife
key_terms.غَادِر: Treacherous one; one who betrays trust or breaks a covenant
key_terms.مَائِل: Lopsided or crooked; referring to a physical deformity
key_terms.نَاكِث: Breaker; one who violates an oath or covenant

ai.seo_question: What are the physical signs of the treacherous and the allegiance-breakers on the Day of Judgment according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, this hadith links the eschatological punishment of the treacherous (ghadir) and those who break their allegiance (nakith) to the Imam with vivid physical deformities, symbolizing their spiritual defects. The 'lopsided jaw' (shidquhu) and 'leprosy' (ajdham) serve as outward manifestations of their inner deceit and covenant-breaking, a concept deeply rooted in Shia exegesis of the Imamate. This narration underscores the severity of betraying the divine authority established by the Prophet, a theme central to Shia political theology.

en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Every treacherous one would come on the Day of Judgment with an imam (leader), with a lopsided mouth until he enters the Fire; and every breaker of the allegiance to an Imam<sup>asws</sup> would come as a leper (mutilated) until he enters the Fire’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali has narrated from his father from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘On the Day of Judgment all the treacherous people will come with a leader, his mouth badly deformed, and end up in the fire. All those breaking out allegiance of the Imam also will come with their hand cut off and end up in the fire.’”
